def dedupe_preserve_order(items):
    """
    Remove duplicates from an iterable while preserving the order of first appearance.

    Parameters
    ----------
    items : Iterable[Hashable]
        The input sequence containing hashable elements.

    Returns
    -------
    list
        A new list with duplicates removed, keeping only the first occurrence of each element.
    """
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result
